basis: Literal and single-row-subquery tuple NULL-safe comparisons must select the same 1997 row; third query establishes the subquery tuple. Compare second rows as multiset (ORDER BY first NULL field does not order ties).
validation_expected: Five IDs 1..5; timestamps 1995..1999-03-04 12:20:00.000000; first two binary values aaa/bbb padded to 11 bytes, last three SQL NULL.
phase_rule: Execute original SQL unchanged and in order, then separately captured read-only validation SQL; validation is required before classification.
on_sql_error: These selected reports target wrong results, not SQL errors; unexpected SQL errors mean execution_failed, never automatically reproduced.
on_other_pattern: other_anomaly; do not attribute an unexpected pattern to the report
transformations_note: Static preparation fixed the obvious extra opening parenthesis before row5 in original INSERT and set UTC explicitly; fixture values retained.
boundary_review_note: All three queries must select only NULL/1997 timestamp row. Target tuple subquery additionally selects 1998 and 1999. UTC and five exact stored rows checked; reuse previously executed fixed INSERT without changes.
